From f1f00d8ff60ca056db3805406507483eeb3794d7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jesper Dangaard Brouer <brouer@redhat.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2015 16:34:51 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] pktgen: adjust flag NO_TIMESTAMP to be more pktgen compliant

Allow flag NO_TIMESTAMP to turn timestamping on again, like other flags,
with a negation of the flag like !NO_TIMESTAMP.

Also document the option flag NO_TIMESTAMP.

Fixes: afb84b626184 ("pktgen: add flag NO_TIMESTAMP to disable timestamping")
Signed-off-by: Jesper Dangaard Brouer <brouer@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/net/core/pktgen.c b/net/core/pktgen.c
index 508155b283dd..43bb21507373 100644
--- a/net/core/pktgen.c
+++ b/net/core/pktgen.c
@@ -1267,6 +1267,9 @@ static ssize_t pktgen_if_write(struct file *file,
 		else if (strcmp(f, "NO_TIMESTAMP") == 0)
 			pkt_dev->flags |= F_NO_TIMESTAMP;
 
+		else if (strcmp(f, "!NO_TIMESTAMP") == 0)
+			pkt_dev->flags &= ~F_NO_TIMESTAMP;
+
 		else {
 			sprintf(pg_result,
 				"Flag -:%s:- unknown\nAvailable flags, (prepend ! to un-set flag):\n%s",
-- 
2.25.1



diff --git a/Documentation/networking/pktgen.txt b/Documentation/networking/pktgen.txt
index 0344f1d45b37..6199ee6a040b 100644
--- a/Documentation/networking/pktgen.txt
+++ b/Documentation/networking/pktgen.txt
@@ -145,6 +145,7 @@ Examples:
                               UDPCSUM,
                               IPSEC # IPsec encapsulation (needs CONFIG_XFRM)
                               NODE_ALLOC # node specific memory allocation
+                              NO_TIMESTAMP # disable timestamping
 
  pgset spi SPI_VALUE     Set specific SA used to transform packet.
 
@@ -287,6 +288,7 @@ flag
   UDPCSUM
   IPSEC
   NODE_ALLOC
+  NO_TIMESTAMP
 
 dst_min
 dst_max

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/core/pktgen.c`**
   - Added functionality to allow the `NO_TIMESTAMP` flag to be negated using `!NO_TIMESTAMP`, which will enable timestamping again.
   - Updated the conditional checks in the `pktgen_if_write` function to handle the new negation case for the `NO_TIMESTAMP` flag.

2. **File: `Documentation/networking/pktgen.txt`**
   - Documented the `NO_TIMESTAMP` flag, including its purpose to disable timestamping.
   - Added examples and descriptions of the `NO_TIMESTAMP` flag in the documentation to clarify its usage.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The changes in `pktgen.c` directly implement the new behavior for the `NO_TIMESTAMP` flag, allowing it to be toggled on and off. The modifications in `pktgen.txt` complement these code changes by providing necessary documentation, ensuring that users understand how to use the new functionality. Together, these modifications enhance the usability and clarity of the `NO_TIMESTAMP` flag in the pktgen tool.
